story.originalTitle: Wolff: Mercedes still need 'crucial' answers about car upgrade
story.summaryEn: Toto Wolff says it is "crucial" for Mercedes to fully understand the potential of their recent upgrade for the development of their 2027 car, after a "step in the right direction" at the Singapore Grand Prix.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫在新加坡大奖赛“不寻常”的规格分歧后，透露了对赛车升级的最新评估。
基米·安东内利在新加坡驾驶了梅赛德斯的升级版赛车，而乔治·拉塞尔在车队马来西亚出现问题后换回了旧版赛车；沃尔夫认为两位车手在下一场比赛中都可能使用新规格赛车；请于10月23日至25日在天空体育F1观看美国大奖赛的每节练习与排位。
乔治·拉塞尔在新加坡冲刺赛因雨延迟期间，接替基米·安东内利的工程师，恶作剧了他的队友！
托托·沃尔夫表示，梅赛德斯需要全面了解近期升级的潜力，这对2027年赛车的开发“至关重要”，此前新加坡大奖赛是“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”。
梅赛德斯采取了沃尔夫承认的“不寻常”做法，在上一场比赛中使用了两种不同的赛车规格，此前在上一站马来西亚为两辆W17引入的重大升级遇到了问题，这是这位世界冠军领跑者自五月以来的首次重大升级。
基米·安东内利在新加坡使用了更新的规格，而乔治·拉塞尔则换回了旧套件，在那个周末他已经知道自己将因引擎处罚而从大奖赛发车格的后排起步。
基米·安东内利如何最早在下一场比赛就赢得F1世界冠军

使用旧版套件的拉塞尔在最初的冲刺赛各节练习与排位中证明是两位车手中更快的一位，随后使用新版套件的安东内利在主要排位赛中更快，之后在大奖赛中获得第三名，向赢得世界冠军迈出了重要一步。
安东内利赛后表示有信心，“我们开始看到隧道尽头的曙光”。
回顾周末结束时的分车测试计划，梅赛德斯车队负责人沃尔夫表示：“我们在这家尖端技术企业里采取了不同寻常的举措，让两辆赛车采用不同配置，因为我们认为需要加速学习曲线，这很好。
“从根本上说，回顾这场比赛，我认为这辆新车需要与上一辆车截然不同的调校理念。这就是我们目前正在学习的东西。
2026年新加坡大奖赛的精彩集锦。
“它像上一辆车那样容易驾驶吗？我不这么认为。它是否具备我们希望升级能带来的性能？我认为目前还没有。但这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。
“在奥斯汀，我们应该看看能否继续巩固这一点，以及它是否还有更多性能，因为这对明年的研发方向至关重要。”
梅赛德斯还在新加坡冲刺赛周末开始时，为安东内利的赛车加装了新的前翼套件，不过在唯一一节练习赛后就被拆下了。
梅赛德斯很可能在奥斯汀为两辆赛车都使用最新套件
沃尔夫补充说，他预计两辆赛车都将在下周的美国大奖赛上使用更新的规格，但最终决定要等车队在奥斯汀之前做出。
“最新的情况是，我们可能想在奥斯汀启用新部件，”他说。
“两位车手都认为这在奥斯汀应该会产生积极效果，或者说应该会有好处，而且我认为就我们为明年学习而言，这是正确的方向。
托托·沃尔夫回击了有关梅赛德斯偏爱基米·安东内利而非乔治·拉塞尔的指责。
“再次说明，我之前就说过，等明天（比赛后的周一）那些聪明人聚在一起之后，以及明天之后，我们会看看我们想要推进的下一个版本会是什么。”

detailEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff reveals latest verdict on car upgrades after 'unusual' specification split at Singapore GP

Kimi Antonelli ran Mercedes' upgraded car in Singapore while George Russell reverted to old one after team's Malaysia issues; Wolff thinks both drivers likely to use new-spec at next race; watch every session of the United States GP on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
George Russell took over from Kimi Antonelli's engineer during the Sprint rain delay in Singapore to prank his team-mate!

Toto Wolff says it is "crucial" for the development of Mercedes' 2027 car that they understand the full extent of their recent upgrade's potential after a "step in the right direction" at the Singapore Grand Prix.

Mercedes took what Wolff admitted was the "unusual" step of running two different car specifications at the last race after troubles with the big car upgrade introduced onto both W17s at the previous round in Malaysia, the world championship leader's first major upgrade since May.

Kimi Antonelli ran the newer spec in Singapore, while George Russell reverted to the older package on a weekend he already knew he would start at the back of the Grand Prix grid owing to engine penalties.

Russell with the older package proved the quicker of the two drivers in the initial Sprint sessions before Antonelli, with the newer package, was then faster in main qualifying before finishing third in the Grand Prix, moving a significant step closer to winning the world title.
Antonelli expressed confidence afterwards that "we started to see the light at the end of the tunnel".

Reflecting on the split programme at the end of the weekend, Mercedes team principal Wolff said: "We made the unusual move in a cutting-edge technology business to have two different cars because we felt we need to accelerate our learning curve and that was good.
"Fundamentally, looking back at the race, I think that this new car needs a very different set-up philosophy than the previous car. This is what we're learning at the moment.
Highlights from the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix.

"Was it an easy car like the previous one? I don't think it was. Does it have the performance that we were hoping the upgrade would bring? I don't think so yet. But it was a step in the right direction.
"In Austin, we should see whether we can continue to consolidate that and whether it has more performance because it's crucial for the development direction for the next year."
Mercedes also added a new front wing to package on Antonelli's car at the start of the Singapore Sprint weekend, although this was taken off after the sole practice session.
Mercedes likely to run both cars with latest package in Austin
Wolff added that he expected that both cars would run the newer specification at next week's United States Grand Prix, pending a final decision by the team before Austin.
"The latest is that we probably want to run the new cars in Austin," he said.
"Both drivers think it should have a positive effect, or it should have a benefit, in Austin, and I think in terms of us learning for next year this is the right direction to go.
Toto Wolff hits back at accusations that Mercedes favour Kimi Antonelli over George Russell.
"Again, I'm saying before the clever groups have come together tomorrow [on Monday after the race] and after tomorrow, we'll see what the next iteration will be we want to go."

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛练习碰撞后抨击马克斯·维斯塔潘，称“总得有人站出来对抗那家伙”。
红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘与梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔将在拉斯维加斯正赛头排发车；拉塞尔在第三节练习碰撞后抨击了维斯塔潘；周日凌晨4点观看正赛（2点30分开始赛前节目），天空体育F1频道和主赛事频道直播。
乔治·拉塞尔回应了拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习中与马克斯·维斯塔潘的碰撞，指责这位红牛车手“坑害”对手。
乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习中与马克斯·维斯塔潘发生碰撞后，对维斯塔潘进行了严厉批评，而两人接下来将在正赛头排一起发车。
这两人近年来在赛道上曾有过摩擦，在第三节练习赛中因争夺赛道位置而发生车轮碰撞。
维斯塔潘先在沿拉斯维加斯大道驶向14号弯的路段超越拉塞尔，随后梅赛德斯赛车在刹车区从红牛赛车内侧反超，两车车轮发生擦碰。

赛会干事调查了该事件并向维斯塔潘发出警告，裁定他在领先梅赛德斯赛车后，在入弯刹车时“驾驶行为异常”。
两人随后在排位赛中分别获得第二和第三，由于第三节排位赛最快车手安东内利被罚退五位发车，这将在周日凌晨4点、天空体育F1直播的比赛中变为头排发车。
乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛最后一次练习赛中相撞
排位赛后，当被问及干事对维斯塔潘的处罚时，拉塞尔表示“警告就够了”，随后对这位红牛对手的做法进行了严厉批评。
拉塞尔对天空体育意大利台表示：“规则里没有任何条款说不能超越正在开始飞驰圈的人，但当你这么做时，你就是在坑害这个人，而他每周都这样对待许多车手，所有人都接受了。”
“我不会就这样接受别人这样坑害我，还表现得好像他们比所有人都更大更强。总得有人站出来对抗那家伙。”
拉塞尔关于想要“站出来对抗”维斯塔潘的言论，与他此前在2024年卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛事件后所说的话如出一辙。
在那次冲突之后，两人当面以及通过采访互相讥讽；当时维斯塔潘因为在Q3阻挡拉塞尔被罚退后一位发车，而这位梅赛德斯车手随后在下一周阿布扎比站比赛前对对手发起了猛烈抨击。
回到2024年，克雷格·斯莱特更仔细地审视了卡塔尔站罚退事件的余波如何在乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘之间升级。
周六，两人在排位赛后新闻发布会上并排而坐时，都被问及最后一次练习赛中的事件，以及关于不打扰即将开始飞驰圈的对手的“君子协定”是否存在任何困惑。
维斯塔潘说“什么都没发生”，而拉塞尔说“没有困惑，我认为这相当清楚”。
评论员们如何看待这次冲突和拉塞尔的言论？
天空体育F1频道的雅克·维伦纽夫谈到事件本身时说：“看起来有趣又刺激！但我们希望在正赛中看到这种情况，而不是在自由练习中。没有必要。”
“一旦你失去了赛道位置，那对你不利。如果你是乔治，你被超越了，这是练习赛。好吧，你拿不回来，你失去了位置，继续前进。”
“那是一个完全没有必要的风险。你不想和马克斯成为敌人。”
回顾红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘与梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔之间一些最激烈的交锋。
在听到拉塞尔排位赛后的言论后，天空体育F1频道的杰米·查德威克表示：“乔治说他会对抗马克斯，我喜欢这一点。这非常让人想起我们在卡塔尔看到的情况。”
“我们知道乔治永远不会向马克斯让步。我认为马克斯确实会尝试在这种事情上碰运气，这就是为什么他能够让自己处于有利位置。这也来自维修区墙上的指令，他们告诉他要穿过车流，奋力争取干净空气，他很有侵略性，确实会把别人挤开。大多数人都会对此让步，然后像利亚姆·劳森（在墨西哥城大奖赛）这样的人出现，不让步，结果惹上了大车队的麻烦。”
“我挺喜欢乔治对抗他这一点，因为马克斯是故意这么做的，他就是那样驾驶的。对此有值得肯定的一面，但也有需要抗争的一面。”
2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛集锦
两人如今将同在前排发车，驶向拉斯维加斯首个弯道的短距离冲刺，维伦纽夫补充道：“两人之间毫无情面可言，这对明天发车前的局面倒是好事！那会让比赛更刺激。”
“他确实不该超越一个即将开始飞驰圈的人，但那个人怎么知道你要开始飞驰圈呢？这是一回事，而且也许你自己也正要开始自己的飞驰圈。
“所以归根结底，这很难判断。”

detailEn: George Russell hits out at Max Verstappen after Las Vegas GP clash and says 'somebody's got to stand up to that guy'

Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Mercedes' George Russell to start on front row of Las Vegas grid; Russell hit out at Verstappen after final practice collision; watch Sunday's race at 4am (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
George Russell reacted to the collision with Max Verstappen in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, accusing the Red Bull driver of of 'screwing' his rivals over

George Russell launched a scathing criticism of Max Verstappen after a collision between the pair in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of a race they will now start on the front row together.
​​​The pair, who have had run-ins in the past on track in recent years, clashed wheels in final practice as they fought over track position.
Verstappen first overtook Russell on the run down The Strip to Turn 14 before the Mercedes went back down the inside of the Red Bull in the braking zone, with the two cars brushing wheels.

Stewards investigated the incident and issued a warning to Verstappen, ruling he had been "driving erratically" under braking into the corner once ahead of the Mercedes.

The pair went on to qualify second and third, which becomes first and second on the grid for Sunday's race at 4am, live on Sky Sports F1, due to Q3 pacesetter Kimi Antonelli's five-place grid penalty.
George Russell and Max Verstappen collided with one another during final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix
Asked after qualifying about the sanction issued to Verstappen by stewards, Russell said "a warning was fine" before going on to issue a withering rebuke of his Red Bull rival's approach.

Russell told Sky Italy: "There's nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap but when you do this, you are screwing this person over and he does this week in, week out with many drivers and everybody accepts it.
"I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else. Somebody's got to stand up to that guy."
Russell's comments about wanting to "stand up to" Verstappen echoed those he made following an incident in qualifying at the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix.

The pair traded barbs in person and via interviews after that clash, when Verstappen was given a one-place grid drop for impeding Russell in Q3, with the Mercedes driver then launching an explosive attack on his rival ahead of the following week's race in Abu Dhabi.
Back in 2024, Craig Slater took a closer look at how the Qatar penalty fallout escalated between George Russell and Max Verstappen

On Saturday, the pair were both asked when sitting next to each other in the post-qualifying press conference about the final practice incident and whether there had any confusion about the 'gentleman's agreement' regarding not disturbing a rival who was about to start a flying lap.
Verstappen said "nothing happened", while Russell said there was "no confusion, I think it was pretty clear".
What did the pundits make of the clash and Russell's comments?
Sky Sports F1's Jacques Villeneuve said of the incident itself: "Fun and exciting to watch! But we want to see this in the race, not in free practice. Unnecessary.
"Once you've lost your track position, too bad for you. If you're George, you got overtaken, it's practice. OK, you don't get it back, you lost your position and move on.
"That was a completely unnecessary risk. You don't want to make an enemy of Max."
A look back at some of the most heated clashes between Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Mercedes' George Russell
Speaking after hearing Russell's post-qualifying comments, Sky Sports F1's Jamie Chadwick said: "George saying he'll stand up to Max, I like that. It's very reminiscent of what we saw in Qatar.

"With George we know he's never going to give to Max. I think Max does try his luck with that kind of thing and that is why he is able to find himself in good positions. It comes also from the pit wall, who are telling him to push through the traffic and fight his way to get clear air, and he's aggressive and he does bully people out of the way. Most people do give in to that and then someone like Liam Lawson [at the Mexico City GP] comes along, doesn't, and gets in trouble from the big team.

"I quite like the fact that George is standing up to him because Max does it intentionally, he drives like that. There is something good to be said for that, but there's also something that needs to be fought against."
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix

With the pair now starting together on the front row for the short run to Las Vegas' first corner, Villeneuve added: "No love lost there, so that's good before the start for tomorrow! That will make it exciting.

"He shouldn't overtake someone who is about to start his lap, true, but how does that person know you're about to start your lap? That's one thing, and maybe you're about to start your own lap yourself.
"So that's a difficult one to judge, ultimately."
